coq.verified: 2026-09-11, this task: coqc -q clean compile + independent Print Assumptions scratch check on all three theorems.
coq.honest_caveats: Mechanizes exactly the combinatorial step the proposal's own how_to_check names: for an ABSTRACT pairwise shell-to-shell transfer coefficient X(s,s') satisfying the antisymmetry X(s,s')=-X(s',s) (the shell-coarsened image of the per-triad convective-coupling antisymmetry C(k;p,q)=-C(p;k,q) the proposal cites), the total double sum sum_s sum_s' X(s,s') is exactly 0, by finite double-sum exchange (proved by induction) plus S=-S => S=0 in Q; and the balance equation itself is proved as the pure algebraic identity it is by construction (T_s defined as Idot_s+2 nu s I_s-F_s). NOT mechanized: deriving the antisymmetry hypothesis X(s,s')=-X(s',s) from the actual Navier-Stokes convective term / incompressible pressure projection acting on a concrete finite Fourier-Galerkin triad set K_N (i.e. going from the cited exact fact sum_k u_k.(u.grad u)_k=0 to a specific triad-indexed C(k;p,q) and then to shell-grouped X), and NOT mechanized as a literal three-index (k,p,q) triad construction -- the pairwise shell-flux X(s,s') formalization is a standard, mathematically equivalent coarsening but is a strictly smaller mechanization than the literal wavevector-triad statement. Tier left at Dr (not upgraded to Th_coqc) because the physical antisymmetry premise is assumed, not derived, here.
